r15-android.title: Shiftbook on an Android phone
body: **Approved in chat (25 Oct):** the phone starts as a companion, the phone and computer swap an encrypted sync file, fingerprint unlock is offered but off by default, due reminders never show titles, and it installs as a signed APK from GitHub releases.

**Check the screens before I build.** Seven phone screens below: the Desk as a list with a bottom bar and a + button, capture as a sheet, unlock with the optional fingerprint, the phone's security settings, the lock-screen reminder, and the two sync screens (making a file, and the check before merging). Swipe or scroll inside the mockup to see them all.

The full write-up is in [Shiftbook in your pocket](https://claude.ai/artifact/CufAB8vtd1KpGsRzwTH967). **First step either way:** a small test build that sets up, locks and unlocks on an Android emulator, which proves the encrypted database works on a phone.

r15-android-ideas.title: Ideas for the phone: small things that make it quicker
body: You asked for more ideas. These eight are phone-only and aimed at logging in a few seconds with one thumb. Each one has a mockup. Pick the ones you want; none of them change the desktop app.
**Privacy holds for all of them:** anything on the lock screen or in the pull-down shows counts and times, never titles, projects or tickets. Anything that touches your data unlocks first.
C, D and F need a little Android code beside Tauri. F and G use the notification plugin you've already said yes to. No other new packages.

figures.caption: Eight phone ideas, A to H. Made-up data.

questions.legend: A · Swipe an entry for +15 min, timer or delete
B · Hour buttons and recent projects in capture
E · The timer asks about time away
F · Timer tile and quiet notification
H · Where was I, on the phone

questions.placeholder: e.g. a bigger + button, or swipe the other way

r15-android-ideas.pick: I'd build B, A and E with the phone layout, then C and D, then F, G and H.
